reference_principles: one unmistakable focal point per slide
large display type paired with compact support copy
coherent identity without repeated card grids

art_direction.visual_thesis: An evidence-led editorial executive deck that makes consequential decisions feel clear, deliberate, and crafted rather than dashboard-like.

reference_scope.quality_floor: Decisive type hierarchy, inspectable proof, controlled light-dark rhythm, and composition-led variety.
reference_scope.anti_copy: Transfer craft principles only; do not copy a marketplace layout, source image, or distinctive reference geometry.

material_language.background: Warm matte paper-like light field or charcoal field, selected by slide tone rather than a generic gradient.
material_language.surface: Quiet flat surfaces with restrained border contrast; cards appear only when information is genuinely modular.
material_language.depth: Subtle separation through scale, tonal contrast, and one soft shadow treatment; no decorative glassmorphism.

edge_language.primary: Rectilinear editorial grid with occasional contained image windows and fine rules.
edge_language.secondary: One intentional rounded or framed motif may recur as furniture, never as a universal card shape.
edge_language.overlap_policy: Overlap only when it creates a clear figure-ground relationship and keeps editable text fully legible.

image_system.reuse_policy: One hero has one primary narrative job. Reuse only for an intentional continuity anchor or low-contrast background texture.
image_system.factual_visual_policy: Actual people, products, UI, charts, and outcomes use supplied or traceable media; generated visuals remain illustrative.

slide_families.purpose: Explain a process or decision logic
Resolve the argument and name the action

selection.audience: decision makers reviewing evidence and a bounded next action
selection.rationale: Use a confident display sans, neutral readable body, and precise mono labels because the audience needs fast claims, inspectable proof, and unambiguous sources without a generic dashboard tone.

quality_floor.thumbnail_test: Primary hierarchy and deck rhythm remain visible at 12 percent scale
quality_floor.squint_test: One focal region is unmistakable before copy is read
quality_floor.evidence_scale: Proof objects are large enough to inspect rather than merely decorate
quality_floor.contrast: Text and critical marks meet WCAG AA where applicable
quality_floor.copy_fit: No headline wraps beyond its budget and no body is shrunk to solve overflow
quality_floor.reference_floor: Visual identity, layout variation, and evidence staging must be at least as deliberate as the relevant supplied reference cluster
quality_floor.target_runtime: Final visuals must be inspected in the requested delivery runtime
